module.purpose: Defines the useSuspenseQueries React hook for TanStack Query, wrapping useQueries to enable Suspense for multiple concurrent queries, and provides recursive conditional types to infer/enforce query option and result tuples.
module.summary: The file exports a React hook that delegates to useQueries while transforming each query to force suspense mode, default error throwing, and enabled state, with a development warning if skipToken is supplied. It also contains extensive TypeScript conditional type machinery that recursively maps arrays of query specifications to typed options and results, using a depth limit to avoid compiler recursion errors. The hook supports an optional combine function for merged results.
module.businessContext: Powers Suspense-based concurrent data fetching in React apps using TanStack Query. If broken, Suspense boundaries hang or throw unexpectedly.

detail.name: useSuspenseQueries
detail.signature: export function useSuspenseQueries(options: any, queryClient?: QueryClient)
preconditions: options must be an object containing a queries array
each item in options.queries must be a query configuration object
postconditions: all queries are executed with suspense enabled
throwOnError is set to defaultThrowOnError for every query
enabled is forced to true for every query
placeholderData is reset to undefined for every query
invariants: every query in the returned result has suspense: true
edgeCases: if a query's queryFn is skipToken in non-production, a console.error is emitted but execution continues
if options.queries is empty, an empty queries array is passed to useQueries
detail.summary: Wraps useQueries to enforce suspense mode on all provided queries, disallowing skipToken usage and enabling throwOnError behavior in non-production environments.
